notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Alterations have been made to the way the instant restart key works. If the player has created a checkpoint then pressing the restart key will now restart the game from the last checkpoint rather than the start of the level.

If the player has not used a level checkpoint then the level will restart instantly as before.
